content: आपत्तिः {%f.%} [आ-पद्-क्तिन्] .²1 Turning or changing into, entering into any state or condition. .²2 Obtaining, procuring, getting; स्थानापत्तेर्द्रव्येषु धर्मलाभः <ls>Kāty.</ls> .²3 Misfortune, calamity, adversity; <ls>Y. 3. 42</ls>. .²4 A fault, transgression. .²5 Remonstrance, expostulation. .²6 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) An undesirable conclusion or occurrence (अनिष्टप्रसङ्ग).
